about: Execution policy of files/dev-work/verification-gate/verify.py: budgets, the frozen scenario names, what a skip may be, and what the routine gate does not yet cover. coverage.json holds the feature identities. A change here changes what PASS means, so this file is part of the policy digest of every run.

m4b-scaling.detail: M4B Converter split at scale against the frozen Phase 7A/7B budgets T1-T8 and T1b and the pinned per-build reference outputs (scaling/README.md); about three hours, never part of a routine mode

pass_requires.about: What a PASS of this scenario must contain (v0.7.2 Phase 9): the gate refuses a PASS verdict with fewer checks or runs, without a named check, or with fewer checks of a family than the whole scenario makes. A check that is missing was not passed.

edge-low-memory.detail: real Microsoft Edge speech through the real TTS panel: eight files in flight at once, a mixed folder with PDFs, Cancel during synthesis and during finalization, Pause then Cancel, and the queue under a real per-process memory limit (qualification/edge_low_memory.py); sends a few hundred short requests, so it runs only with --network online-edge and is BLOCKED without it

optional-engines.detail: bounded real synthesis, offline, on the Kokoro, Chatterbox Turbo and Qwen3-TTS already installed on this computer: two voices each, multi-chunk text, eight workers asked for and one used, the published MP3 decoded and measured (qualification/optional_engines.py); never downloads, a missing engine or model is BLOCKED

Qwen3 ran in its own engine process

fresh-windows.detail: the committed application packaged by the real packager and audited, extracted fresh, set up by the real first-run base setup, launched, repaired offline after controlled damage, stopped during setup and completed offline from kept files, failed cleanly offline with nothing to reuse and then finished by the next start once the network was back (qualification/fresh_windows.py); downloads about 1.6 GB into the gate's scratch, so it runs only with --network online-setup and is BLOCKED without it; a fresh extraction on this Windows 11 account, not a new Windows installation

names: this run is not elevated: setup needs no administrator rights

win32.pattern: ^(aqua geometry regression: native macOS metrics only|the aqua branch needs aqua)$
^(this filesystem is case-insensitive, so the two names are one file|the Windows path layer is case-blind by definition)$
^(set JACK_RYAN_M4B_FOLDER to the Jack Ryan fixture folder to run|no local A4 listening folder|no local ordered export|files/runtime-data/ currently holds no colliding test basename)$
^loads the multi-gigabyte model; set ACT_OMNIVOICE_P1_REAL=1 where it is installed$
win32.why: v0.8.0: the one routine skip of files/tests/test_omnivoice_phase1.py::test_real_clone_proof, the only test with this reason. It loads the multi-gigabyte OmniVoice model and runs only with ACT_OMNIVOICE_P1_REAL=1 on a computer where the engine is installed; the routine gate never sets it. This skip is evidence of nothing: the real clone is proven only by that opt-in run (Phase 1, recorded in the Handoff) and by the release qualification and owner listening that coverage.json lists as release-pending for OmniVoice.

win32.pattern: ^(native\ macOS\ only\ \(P1A\):\ bash\ 3\.2\ stage\ 0,\ POSIX\ process\ groups,\ Mach\-O\ and\ codesign\ checks)$
win32.why: v0.8.x P1A/P1B review: the macOS-native tests of P1A (stage 0 in bash 3.2, POSIX containment, Mach-O, codesign and the adopted Riedl build): 44 marked in test_bootstrap_host_macos.py (29), test_child_ownership.py (10) and test_macos_foundation.py (5), plus the real aac_at decodes of test_macos_xhe_proof.py that skip at run time (1, and the AAC-LC control audiobook test when the owner's local file is present: 46 at most). Their Windows counterparts are the existing Windows suites; nothing Windows ran before is skipped by this rule.

win32.pattern: ^(native\ macOS\ only\ \(P1B\):\ Aqua\ Tk\ 9\ shell,\ POSIX\ containment\ and\ macOS\ filesystem\ checks)$
win32.why: v0.8.x P1B: the macOS-native tests of the Aqua Tk 9 shell, the app window as a POSIX containment owner (KX-1(d,e), KX-2(d), KX-3(d), KX-6, KX-7, KX-8) and the macOS filesystem primitives: test_macos_p1b_containment.py (15), test_macos_p1b_platform.py (15), test_macos_p1b_gui_containment.py (13), test_macos_p1b_filesystem.py (10: exFAT and APFS disk images, read-only and full volumes, output permissions, two app copies, the measured descriptor peak), test_macos_p1b_mainthread.py (1: MAC-032) and test_macos_p1b_publication_cancel.py (8: CX-8). The same files' Windows controls run on Windows, and test_macos_p1b_gate.py (16) runs everywhere.

win32.pattern: ^(the\ owner's\ local\ AAC\-LC\ control\ audiobook\ is\ not\ here|set\ ACT_XHE_PROOF_APPLE_CAF\ to\ afconvert's\ LEI16\ decode\ of\ the\ owner's\ xHE\-AAC\ fixture\ \(about\ 6\ GB\)\ to\ run\ the\ real\ proof\ 8)$
win32.why: v0.8.x P1B review of P1A: two tests of test_macos_xhe_proof.py name the owner's local media or a 6 GB decode by their own skip reason before the platform is asked; on Windows they skip for that reason. At most one each.

darwin.pattern: ^(Windows\ process\ identity|Windows\ console\ and\ process\ identity|the\ identity\ checks\ read\ Windows\ process\ creation\ times|Job\ Objects\ are\ Windows'|Job\ Objects\ are\ a\ Windows\ mechanism|Windows\ Job\ Object\ containment|handles\ are\ a\ Windows\ primitive|an\ open\ handle\ only\ blocks\ deletion\ on\ Windows|an\ open\ handle\ only\ blocks\ a\ rename\ on\ Windows|what\ Windows\ reports|the\ guard\ is\ a\ no\-op\ off\ Windows\ by\ design|the\ launcher/child\ arrangement\ is\ the\ Windows\ venv's|the\ stand\-in\ ffmpeg\ is\ a\ Windows\ \.cmd\ wrapper|the\ measured\ crash\ and\ its\ exit\ status\ are\ Windows'|a\ Windows\ lock|Media\ Foundation\ is\ Windows')$
darwin.why: Tests of Windows process, Job Object, handle, console and Media Foundation mechanics. Their macOS counterparts are native: POSIX containment (test_child_ownership.py, test_macos_p1b_containment.py, test_macos_p1b_gui_containment.py: KX-1 to KX-9), the POSIX stop_media_children and closing latch, the renamex_np publication, and aac_at decoding (test_macos_xhe_proof.py). Counted from the P1B affected-suite census on macOS (226 files).

darwin.pattern: ^(junctions\ are\ a\ Windows\ mechanism|junctions\ are\ a\ Windows\-only\ facility|a\ junction\ is\ the\ Windows\ link\ that\ needs\ no\ privilege|a\ directory\ junction\ is\ a\ Windows\ link|junctions\ are\ a\ Windows\ construct|FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN\ is\ a\ Windows\-only\ facility|Windows\ long\ paths\ exist\ on\ Windows\ only|Windows\ paths\ compare\ without\ regard\ to\ case|only\ Windows\ can\ bind\ a\ roll\-back's\ move\ to\ the\ file\ itself;\ elsewhere\ a\ roll\-back\ moves\ nothing.*|an\ exclusive\ open\ is\ how\ Windows\ reports\ a\ holder|a\ junction\ is\ the\ Windows\ link\ available\ without\ privilege|PurePath\ is\ only\ the\ Windows\ flavour\ on\ Windows)$
darwin.why: Junctions, the hidden attribute, Windows long paths and case rules, and the handle-bound roll-back: Windows filesystem facilities. macOS's own (APFS and exFAT no-clobber, NFD names, case folding by the volume) are tested natively in test_macos_p1b_platform.py and test_macos_p1b_filesystem.py.

darwin.pattern: ^(exercises\ the\ Windows\ candidate\ locations\ \(LOCALAPPDATA\ /\ ProgramFiles\)|Windows\ PowerShell\ is\ needed|exercises\ the\ Windows\ \.bat\ launcher|the\ app's\ own\ base\ Python\ is\ the\ Windows\ layout|stage\ 0\ is\ Windows\ PowerShell)$
darwin.why: The Windows first-run host (PowerShell, the .bat launcher, the Windows Python locations and venv layout). macOS stage 0 and its venv are P1A's native tests (test_bootstrap_host_macos.py, test_macos_foundation.py).

darwin.pattern: ^(the\ ACT\ design\ system\ only\ applies\ on\ win32|the\ Windows\ bundle's\ metrics\ only\ apply\ on\ win32|the\ ACT\ Windows\ shell\ only\ builds\ on\ win32|the\ measured\ breakpoints\ are\ Windows\ metrics|process\ DPI\ awareness\ is\ a\ Windows\ concept|aqua\ keeps\ native\ controls|aqua\ drop\-downs\ are\ native|aqua\ keeps\ native\ controls\ \(and\ the\ Phase\ 8\ Toolbutton\ restyle\))$
darwin.why: The ACT Windows design system, its measured breakpoints and DPI. The Aqua shell keeps native controls and is tested natively by the aqua branches of the same suites and test_macos_p1b_platform.py.

darwin.pattern: ^(920x600\ is\ below\ the\ aqua\ minimum|920x600\ is\ below\ ui_theme\.AQUA_MIN_SIZE;\ unreachable\ through\ the\ real\ macOS\ launcher)$
darwin.why: Windows' 920x600 minimum is below the Aqua minimum, so the window can never be that size on macOS; the Aqua minimum itself is tested at its own size by the same suites.

darwin.pattern: ^(the\ benchmark\ harness\ accounts\ through\ Windows\ Job\ Objects|Windows\ behaviour|a\ Windows\ desktop|a\ Windows\ named\ mutex|console\ hosts\ and\ Job\ Objects\ are\ Windows)$
darwin.why: The Windows verification gate's own adapters (Job Objects, the native desktop, the named-mutex lease, console hosts). The macOS gate's counterparts are its darwin preflight and the in-process journey driver (adapters/macos).

darwin.pattern: ^(recovering\ another\ process's\ files\ is\ proved\ on\ Windows\ only)$
darwin.why: Recovery of another process's work area is proved on Windows only. On macOS the optional D11b counterpart (shared/work_area.py on the P1A start-time reader) is not implemented in P1B; the gap is open issue ACT72-076 in coverage.json's ledger, not hidden.

darwin.pattern: ^(the\ guard\ is\ a\ Windows\ named\ mutex;\ Qwen3\ is\ Windows\-only|the\ guard\ is\ a\ Windows\ named\ mutex|no\ Qwen3\ environment\ or\ Base\ model\ on\ this\ machine)$
^(files/dev\-work/\ currently\ holds\ no\ colliding\ test\ basename|files/runtime\-data/\ currently\ holds\ no\ colliding\ test\ basename|the\ Riedl\ 9\.0\.1\ ZIPs\ are\ not\ downloaded\ here)$
darwin.why: Local fixtures that are absent on this computer; the tests run where they are present.
A parametrisation empty on this platform.

darwin.pattern: ^(this\ filesystem\ is\ case\-insensitive,\ so\ the\ two\ names\ are\ one\ file)$
darwin.why: The default APFS volume folds case; the case-sensitive behaviour is tested where the volume keeps case.

acceptance.about: The native Windows GUI and real-media journeys. A full run requires every scenario in required_scenarios; the runner's registered set must equal required plus optional, so a scenario cannot appear or vanish without an edit here. optional_scenarios need a declared applicability rule with evidence, and even then say nothing about engine qualification.

acceptance.darwin_about: v0.8.x P1B (plan 14.3, MAC-045, D9): every required scenario and the optional one, exactly one class each. automated: the same journey run by the in-process macOS driver (adapters/macos: real panels, real media, real FFmpeg, acts through Tk, dialogs answered by in-process stand-ins), with its native-dialog steps owner-manual where 'manual' names them; pending_phase: mapped but not yet runnable on macOS, reported NOT RUN until that phase. not-applicable: only a test of the Windows input harness itself, with an owner-reviewed reason id. A darwin acceptance stage fails on an unmapped scenario, a failed automated counterpart, a NOT RUN required scenario or a manual item without signed evidence for the candidate SHA; it is never a blanket NOT APPLICABLE.

fresh-macos.phase: P1B (contract and procedure); P6a rehearsal; P7c REAL CLEAN
fresh-macos.detail: The packaged archive extracted fresh (quarantined, as a download is), stage 0, the first run, all six tools opened, the .venv damaged and repaired, the app relaunched, an install interrupted and recovered. Mandatory (D9b); its automation is optional. Without a runner it is satisfied only by the owner's run of the written procedure with signed evidence naming the candidate SHA, and its verdict carries its evidence class: SIMULATED, P6a rehearsal or REAL CLEAN (P7c needs REAL CLEAN). A missing run is NOT RUN and blocks publication.
